commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Tetsuo Imperial attacks EQUIPPED for a chosen noncombat burn based on highest attached Equipment MV or casts a matching MV instant/sorcery from hand for free. Multiple extra combats, attachment cheats and a tightly integrated poison/burn Equipment kill remain the engine.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized. A three-color commander needs Equipment preattached, exposed attacks and hand spells; lethal infect/extra combat pressure is powerful but interactable and not a generic cEDH backup.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: No Thoracle/Consult, Ad Nauseam, Breach, deterministic combo pile or unconnected Grixis goodstuff. Tutors, mana, protection and draw must accelerate Tetsuo's Equipment attack / free-cast / noncombat damage route.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: 99/99 original library physical slots independently reconciled in companion 99-slot ledger using authored source annotations plus current-cycle judgments: 86 KEEP / 13 CUT. Expensive high-MV Equipment and their attach cheats are protected; interaction, free-cast payloads, extra-combat timings and red/blue/black mana were challenged. New infect and doubled damage are conditional commander-native wins, not generic unrelated combos.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 35 land cards unchanged. Canonical 5 Island/4 Mountain/3 Swamp become 4 Island/4 Mountain/2 Swamp, with +Otawara and +Shizo; always-tapped/conditional Smoldering Marsh becomes City of Brass. Three-color commander cost UBR; City removes a tapped/fetchable bottleneck, Otawara/Shizo offer colored utility; two fewer fetchable basics increase nonbasic hate exposure. Existing Arcane Signet, Sol Ring, three signets/three talismans, Ancient Tomb and typed dual/fetch land access retained.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Keep Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Withering Torment, Blasphemous Act, Chandra's Ignition, Mithril Coat and Swiftfoot Boots. Trading Terminate for Tutor cuts a cheap creature kill, offset by Drach'Nyen ETB exile and Mjolnir ETB creature damage; missing untargeted artifact hate remains an enemy risk.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Akki Battle Squad is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Karlach costs five rather than six, grants first strike and works without checking modification; trades away a Samurai body.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Costs five and can draw removal; unlike Akki, isn't a Samurai for Godo's Samurai untap.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Argentum Armor is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Both equipment are MV6, but Drach'Nyen exiles an enemy creature on entry and equips for two; lose repeatable any-permanent destruction.
weakest_slots.reasoning: No longer destroy an arbitrary permanent on repeated combat like Argentum Armor.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Brainstorm is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; A normal main-phase Will accelerates equipment, and free-casting during attack grants end-turn access to three cards; attack-step red mana cannot be banked for the main.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Combat-phase red mana empties before main and exiled cards obey normal timing; loses one-blue Brainstorm fixing.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Heiko Yamazaki, the General is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Firion supplies haste and duplicates nonlegendary equipment for a turn to reduce equip costs; loses persistent artifact recursion.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Heiko's permanent artifact graveyard access is lost; legendary Equipment copies conflict with legend rule and token sacrifices next upkeep.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Island is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Untapped U land offers discounted legend-enabled bounce interaction; loses a fetchable basic.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Nonbasic fails basic fetch/anti-nonbasic effects and bounce can cost mana.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Kediss only spreads combat damage, not Tetsuo's attack-trigger burn; Strike can give that burn infect in response for a lethal 10-poison line.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Needs open B/priority and a legal targeting window; cannot deal damage and free-cast Strike from the same Tetsuo trigger.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Smoldering Marsh is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Any-color untapped mana improves three-color setup; costs life and loses a typed fetch target.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Life paid on each tap and nonbasic vulnerability replace typed/fetchable fixing.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Swamp is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Untapped B plus one-mana legendary fear helps commander land combat-damage Equipment triggers; loses basic Swamp fetch/resilience.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Fear still fails against black/artifact blockers and the Swamp basic count decreases.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Sword of Fire and Ice is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Mjölnir is attachable to red legendary Tetsuo for one and doubles his attack-trigger damage; lose on-hit draw and two damage.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Does not draw a card on player contact as Sword of Fire and Ice does; only four MV.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Terminate is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Tutor can find exact Equipment, attach cheat, infect payoff or protection; lose efficient two-mana creature removal.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Sacrifices a cheap creature answer before Tetsuo is online; tutor is not itself a board answer.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's The Reality Chip is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Infect makes Tetsuo's triggered noncombat damage a direct poison win route; loses top-deck spell access and gains unattach-sacrifice risk.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Destroying or moving the Equipment sacrifices its formerly equipped permanent; requires protection.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Vorpal Sword is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; R instant can attach expensive Equipment to Tetsuo before attack even without equip activation; loses eight-mana hit-to-kill activation.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Needs Equipment in play, a creature target, and a card in hand; no Equipment fetch.

weakest_slots.weakness: The exact baseline's Winged Boots is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Equip legendary one gives unblockable and ward two; loses flying and the larger ward from Winged Boots.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Ward is only two versus Winged Boots' stronger protection and does not preserve flying.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-mana protective artifact creature is challenged by a three-mana extra-combat body, but protection matters against repeated artifact removal.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: Padeem provides artifact hexproof and can draw with the largest Equipment, while Celebrant often cannot attack safely.

weakest_slots.weakness: A low-MV collar caps free casts if attached alone, so Shadowspear's trample and indestructible-stripping is credible.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: Collar converts Tetsuo's NONCOMBAT attack-trigger damage to deathtouch/lifelink, especially to neutralize gigantic blockers.

weakest_slots.weakness: Attack-based land ramp is slow and requires connecting or at least attacking with attachment; Bitterthorn creates an incidental creature.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain: Sword is already a cheap attachable two-mana ramp piece; Bitterthorn duplicates the same role without a conclusive upgrade.

whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: Important new synergy missed by the old candidate pool: Magnetic Theft instant attach R, Firion one-turn Equipment copy + haste, Mjolnir damage doubling even for Tetsuo ability, Grafted Exoskeleton infect for NONCOMBAT attack burn, and Tainted Strike B response. Test pitfalls include legend rule copies, Exoskeleton unattach sacrifice, Savage Beating entwine payment, World at War timing, and Jeska combat mana emptying.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Thirteen swaps improve attach access, haste, poison/burn and double-damage attack modes, extra combats, top-card access/tutor, untapped/legend fixing and cheap high-MV removal. They lose some blue draw, a basic pair, a two-mana creature kill, a persistent artifact recursion line and a repeatable Argentum removal mode; those costs are quantified by named incumbents and high-counterplay scenarios, not concealed by the swap count.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Akki Battle Squad is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Karlach costs five rather than six, grants first strike and works without checking modification; trades away a Samurai body.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Costs five and can draw removal; unlike Akki, isn't a Samurai for Godo's Samurai untap.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Argentum Armor is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Both equipment are MV6, but Drach'Nyen exiles an enemy creature on entry and equips for two; lose repeatable any-permanent destruction.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: No longer destroy an arbitrary permanent on repeated combat like Argentum Armor.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Brainstorm is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; A normal main-phase Will accelerates equipment, and free-casting during attack grants end-turn access to three cards; attack-step red mana cannot be banked for the main.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Combat-phase red mana empties before main and exiled cards obey normal timing; loses one-blue Brainstorm fixing.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Heiko Yamazaki, the General is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Firion supplies haste and duplicates nonlegendary equipment for a turn to reduce equip costs; loses persistent artifact recursion.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Heiko's permanent artifact graveyard access is lost; legendary Equipment copies conflict with legend rule and token sacrifices next upkeep.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Island is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Untapped U land offers discounted legend-enabled bounce interaction; loses a fetchable basic.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Nonbasic fails basic fetch/anti-nonbasic effects and bounce can cost mana.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Kediss, Emberclaw Familiar is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Kediss only spreads combat damage, not Tetsuo's attack-trigger burn; Strike can give that burn infect in response for a lethal 10-poison line.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Needs open B/priority and a legal targeting window; cannot deal damage and free-cast Strike from the same Tetsuo trigger.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Smoldering Marsh is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Any-color untapped mana improves three-color setup; costs life and loses a typed fetch target.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Life paid on each tap and nonbasic vulnerability replace typed/fetchable fixing.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Swamp is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Untapped B plus one-mana legendary fear helps commander land combat-damage Equipment triggers; loses basic Swamp fetch/resilience.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Fear still fails against black/artifact blockers and the Swamp basic count decreases.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Sword of Fire and Ice is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Mjölnir is attachable to red legendary Tetsuo for one and doubles his attack-trigger damage; lose on-hit draw and two damage.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Does not draw a card on player contact as Sword of Fire and Ice does; only four MV.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Terminate is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Tutor can find exact Equipment, attach cheat, infect payoff or protection; lose efficient two-mana creature removal.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Sacrifices a cheap creature answer before Tetsuo is online; tutor is not itself a board answer.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's The Reality Chip is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Infect makes Tetsuo's triggered noncombat damage a direct poison win route; loses top-deck spell access and gains unattach-sacrifice risk.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Destroying or moving the Equipment sacrifices its formerly equipped permanent; requires protection.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Vorpal Sword is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; R instant can attach expensive Equipment to Tetsuo before attack even without equip activation; loses eight-mana hit-to-kill activation.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Needs Equipment in play, a creature target, and a card in hand; no Equipment fetch.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: The exact baseline's Winged Boots is weaker in Tetsuo's new 13-swap physical package; Equip legendary one gives unblockable and ward two; loses flying and the larger ward from Winged Boots.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Ward is only two versus Winged Boots' stronger protection and does not preserve flying.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: Four-mana protective artifact creature is challenged by a three-mana extra-combat body, but protection matters against repeated artifact removal.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Retain: Padeem provides artifact hexproof and can draw with the largest Equipment, while Celebrant often cannot attack safely.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: A low-MV collar caps free casts if attached alone, so Shadowspear's trample and indestructible-stripping is credible.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Retain: Collar converts Tetsuo's NONCOMBAT attack-trigger damage to deathtouch/lifelink, especially to neutralize gigantic blockers.

weakest_slot_challenge.weakness: Attack-based land ramp is slow and requires connecting or at least attacking with attachment; Bitterthorn creates an incidental creature.
weakest_slot_challenge.reasoning: Retain: Sword is already a cheap attachable two-mana ramp piece; Bitterthorn duplicates the same role without a conclusive upgrade.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Complete 100 alt14 adds Combat Celebrant while cutting Padeem in addition to the 13 selected changes; plausible additional attack but fragile and lowers artifact protection against removal.

Complete 100 alt15 adds Combat Celebrant and Sword of Wealth and Power, cutting Padeem and Chandra's Ignition. Better on-hit copying but Sword's protection disables targeting Tetsuo with Tainted Strike, and loses the five-mana team damage sweeper.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Reexamined historical M6/PassC Bitterthorn vs Leyline Axe, Colossus Hammer's low MV, and Grok-flagged Swordsman's Steel/Mithril Coat. Neither weakening the 12-MV threshold nor dropping flashing indestructibility exceeds selected enhanced access/damage.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The historical KEEP overvalued consistency of the 12 already approved old swaps and failed to compare direct-damage infect/double-damage plus one-red attachment changes, and did not challenge the low-MV Vorpal Sword or Kediss combat-only text against Tetsuo's NONCOMBAT damage mode.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: The new 13-card package directly changes how often the commander attacks equipped, what that attack produces and how much it can immediately threaten. Source-based downsides are real, but two larger complete alternatives produce inferior protection and targeting access; the 13-swap outcome is a justified commander-native M7 upgrade.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After finding the selected 13 swaps, all retained original positions were reconsidered by role. The distinct post-floor live candidates examined Padeem vs Combat Celebrant, Basilisk Collar vs Shadowspear, Sword of the Animist vs Bitterthorn, Kaldra Compleat vs Tatsumasa, Mechanaut vs Bladegraft, Mithril Coat vs Helm, and Chandra Ignition vs Wealth. These are not token eleventh-hour swaps: each removes a substantive existing effect, and full 100-card competing lists are staged.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Three-mana exerted extra combat is real when attacking with Tetsuo, but it is a fragile 4/1 without immediate haste, and removing Padeem exposes all artifact Equipment to targeted removal plus loses possible card draw.
Shadowspear trample and temporary indestructible removal aid combat kills, but loses deathtouch on Tetsuo's attack-trigger NONCOMBAT damage, which kills oversized creatures with a one-MV Equipment.
A similar repeated attack-fetch basic ramp slot with a living Equipment token, but changing the reliable Sword ramp payoff does not improve infect or high MV enough for the additional setup cost.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Fourteenth change gives a three-mana Combat Celebrant additional attack, creating more chances to use Tetsuo's attack trigger and Equipment hit payoff.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Padeem is a material artifact-hexproof and high-MV-card-draw shield; Celebrant must survive and attack with support, is fragile, and overlaps Karlach/Godo/Genji/Hexplate. Complete fourteen swaps are worse against instant equipment hate.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Fifteenth-swap portfolio tests the further EDHREC Sword of Wealth and Power damage-on-hit Treasure/instant-copy engine, giving up Chandra's Ignition and Padeem alongside the extra Celebrant.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Sword grants Tetsuo protection from INSTANTS so the selected Tainted Strike can't legally target him while attached; it also trades out Chandra's high-ceiling direct damage boardwipe and Padeem artifact protection. Double-value on connecting is too conditional for the complete infect/burn route.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stop is determined by actual commander-function gains, not thirteen as a number: the coherent poison/doubled noncombat damage, one-red attachment, faster extra combat and colored utility upgrade package preserves 35 lands and the core free-spell weapons. Further credible fourteen/fifteen full 100 options remove artifact protection or create their own targeting prohibition, while other evaluated high-MV equipment require worse mana/equip costs or reduce haste/card access. No positive-value remaining complete multi-slot challenger survived the cost and rules review.
